101: def _wait_for_pending_paused_revision_v1(
102:     driver: object, snapshot: Mapping[str, object], pending: Mapping[str, object],
103: ) -> None:
104:     """Use the native driver's existing bounded snapshot wait, then replan."""
105:     waiter = getattr(driver, "_wait_for_snapshot", None)
106:     if not callable(waiter):
107:         raise BridgeUnavailableError("private faction pending frame has no bounded native wait")
108:     old_revision = snapshot.get("revision")
109:     pre_revision = pending.get("pre_snapshot_revision")
110:     if not (
111:         type(old_revision) is int and type(pre_revision) is int
112:         and snapshot.get("date_raw") == pending.get("pre_date_raw")
113:         and snapshot.get("episode_run_id") == pending.get("episode_run_id")
114:         and snapshot.get("paused") is True
115:         and snapshot.get("map_ready") is True
116:     ):
117:         raise BridgeUnavailableError("private faction pending frame changed before receipt")
118: 
119:     def changed_or_ready(current: Mapping[str, object]) -> bool:
120:         revision = current.get("native_revision")
121:         return bool(
122:             (type(revision) is int and revision > pre_revision)
123:             or current.get("date_raw") != pending.get("pre_date_raw")
124:             or current.get("episode_run_id") != pending.get("episode_run_id")
125:             or current.get("played_character") != snapshot.get("played_character")
126:             or current.get("paused") is not True
127:             or current.get("map_ready") is not True
128:             or current.get("active_event") is not None
129:             or current.get("pending_character_interaction") is not None
130:         )
131: 
132:     fresh = waiter(dict(snapshot), changed_or_ready, timeout_seconds=5.0)
133:     if not (
134:         isinstance(fresh, Mapping)
135:         and type(fresh.get("revision")) is int
136:         and fresh["revision"] > old_revision
137:         and type(fresh.get("native_revision")) is int
138:         and fresh["native_revision"] > pre_revision
139:         and fresh.get("date_raw") == pending.get("pre_date_raw")
140:         and fresh.get("episode_run_id") == pending.get("episode_run_id")
141:         and fresh.get("played_character") == snapshot.get("played_character")
142:         and fresh.get("paused") is True
143:         and fresh.get("map_ready") is True
144:         and fresh.get("active_event") is None
145:         and fresh.get("pending_character_interaction") is None
146:     ):
147:         raise BridgeUnavailableError(
148:             "private faction pending same-date paused revision did not arrive"
149:         )
150:     # native_auto_run already catches this exact pre-submission condition and
151:     # performs one bounded readiness replan; no gameplay request was sent.
152:     raise PreSubmissionRevisionMismatchError(
153:         "private faction pending receipt has a newer same-date paused frame"
154:     )
